connector.name: Yggdrasil
connector.registryDescription: One shared, durable memory for your AI coding agents - local-first, zero-dependency.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package yggdrasil-memory. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vondervuflya account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YGG_ENGINE_URL

env.name: YGG_ENGINE_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for authenticating to the Yggdrasil engine (from ~/.yggdrasil/token after `ygg install`).
